scope.summary: Implement genital collision proxies and soft-tissue coupling for insertion scenes (spec 13.21; REQ-034): penis shaft/glans capsule chains and orifice canal colliders generated from genital channel state via the MT-541 generator, with optional BkSoftTissue cage simulation on penis base/scrotum and vulva/mons honoring erection firmness state, feeding the Cloth world for garment bulge.
acceptance_criteria: Genital colliders: penis shaft/glans capsule chain plus orifice canal colliders generated from genital channel state through the MT-541 autocollider generator, updating with length/girth/gape channel changes.

Soft-tissue coupling: penis base/scrotum and vulva/mons regions optionally cage-simulated so contact in insertion scenes squishes correctly; coupling honors firmness/engorgement state (erect is firmer per the MT-552 state machine).
Insertion scene test: a posed penetration with colliders active produces contact resolution without tunneling at documented step rates.
Proxies feed the Cloth collision world: a garment draped over an erect cock shows the correct bulge (drape smoke test).
scope.risk_if_missed: Insertion scenes without genital collision and soft-tissue coupling read as rigid intersection (REQ-034); garments over an erect penis also drape flat without the proxy feed, breaking a basic wardrobe-plus-arousal production setup.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
